MOZ.note: Training is for secondary students, not civil servants.

facts.fact: A memorandum signed on 2 May 2025 by the Ministry of Education and partners to expand the DiGi project, led by the Machel Fidus Association, which is already running in 24 public secondary schools across all provinces and has trained more than 900 students.

systems.owner: Machel Fidus Association with Ministry of Education and Culture, Vodacom Foundation, Huawei

MOZ.note: Free connectivity to 263 schools is a connectivity programme with no share of secondary schools; no compulsory subject stated.
